name: git-workflows
description: Write useful changelogs, reviewable commits and pull requests with verified context and repository privacy.

interface.shortDescription: Useful changelogs, reviewable commits and pull requests.
interface.longDescription: Keep changelogs current before task completion, create small commits and concise pull requests, and preserve unrelated work and repository privacy.
defaultPrompt: Commit the intended changes as small, reviewable commits.
Write and save a pull request for the completed change.
Update the changelog for the completed change.
